006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IBase64BinaryItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
021
022/**
023 * Provides a new Metapath function that decodes provided encoded text using
024 * base64.
025 *
026 */
027public final class MpBase64Decode {
028  private static final String NAME = "base64-decode-text";
029
030  @NonNull
031  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_ONE_ARG = IFunction.builder()
032      .name(NAME)
033      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_EXTENDED)
034      .deterministic()
035      .contextIndependent()
036      .focusIndependent()
037      .argument(IArgument.builder()
038          .name("encodedText")
039          .type(IBase64BinaryItem.type())
040          .one()
041          .build())
042      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
043      .returnOne()
044      .functionHandler(MpBase64Decode::executeOneArg)
045      .build();
046
047  private MpBase64Decode() {
048    // disable construction
049  }
050
051  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
052  @NonNull
053  private static ISequence<IStringItem> executeOneArg(
054      @NonNull IFunction function,
055      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
056      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
057      IItem focus) {
058    IBase64BinaryItem encodedText
059        = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
060    return ISequence.of(encodedText.decodeAsString());
061  }
062}
